cards.name: Emergentism
cards.candidate_application: Emergentism uses the stack to keep raw arrivals, structured maps, claims, editorial Judgments, reusable policy, and public projection source-separated while the Soul Loop returns consequence to revision.
cards.survivor_if_rejected: The cited sources, ordinary versioning, native audit practices, and correction records remain.

cards.name: APU
cards.candidate_application: APU may be read as a bounded intake and gate surface that keeps untrusted arrivals below durable claim or decision status until explicit checks and promotion events occur.
cards.survivor_if_rejected: APU's native gate specification and source ownership remain unchanged.

cards.name: Circle / IS
cards.candidate_application: Circle may preserve sourced observations and reported claims as provenance-bearing Information while refusing to manufacture cause, likelihood, recommendation, decision, or outcome; any public field remains a separate projection.
cards.survivor_if_rejected: Circle's sourced-IS boundary and correction chain remain authoritative in its own lane.

cards.name: RealityFutures / COULD
cards.candidate_application: RealityFutures may transform sourced Information into uncertainty-bearing forecasts and calibration records without promoting COULD into IS, SHOULD, Judgment, authority, or execution; resolution evidence returns through a separate loop.
cards.survivor_if_rejected: RealityFutures retains its native forecast, uncertainty, calibration, and ownership boundaries.

cards.name: Agentz / SHOULD
cards.candidate_application: Agentz may compile sourced IS and uncertainty-bearing COULD into an unsigned SHOULD proposal while keeping proposal distinct from the Judgment, mandate, execution, receipt, and independent outcome that only later bearers may supply.
cards.survivor_if_rejected: Agentz remains a non-authorizing decision compiler under its own Applied Rosetta boundary.

cards.name: Skyzai constraint boundary
cards.candidate_application: Skyzai's whole-boundary may be read as a non-authorizing constraint and coherence check around Judgment and policy reuse; HOLD, RETURN, or PASS cannot become approval, signing authority, execution, or evidence of outcome.
cards.survivor_if_rejected: Skyzai's native constraint dispositions and external-authority firewall remain.

cards.name: Menexus / Cortex · AIA · Nexus
cards.candidate_application: Menexus may render the stack as an explanatory promotion lens over typed records: Cortex preserves accepted lineage, AIA requests or explains bounded transformations, and Nexus carries scoped views; none of the seven labels becomes a folder, domain type, truth rank, or authority source.
cards.survivor_if_rejected: Menexus retains its native commitment kernel, domain kinds, promotion states, retention, visibility, and external-authority separation.

cards.name: Evolutionary.Network field practice
cards.candidate_application: Evolutionary.Network may test whether selected guidance survives voluntary seven-function practice in the actual world, returning independent consequence rather than self-certification; the Ventures network and Skyzai L1 organ remain distinct source owners.
cards.survivor_if_rejected: The selected people-network charter, functions-not-ranks fence, and separate Skyzai organ remain unchanged.
